---
title: "Characterizing the academic OSPO in 2026"
---

# Overview

Here I am getting some background on the size and status of surveyed OSPOs.

Research questions:\
- Where are university OSPOs located within their university?\
- How many of the organizations have an OSPO or dedicated OSPO staff? How many organizations just have staff doing OSPO-like work as part of another role?\
- How old are the OSPOs?\
- How big are the OSPOs?\
- What fraction of OSPO contributors are volunteers?\

Relevant survey questions:\
- Which best describes the open source function at your organization?\
- What is the open source enabling function called within your organization?\
- Where is your OSPO located within your university?\
- How long has your OSPO been operating?\
- Roughly how much total staff time is formally spent on OSPO or OSPO-like activities in your organization?\
- Beyond that, roughly how many people regularly spend time on OSPO activities without being formally resourced?\
